en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Numan, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Abu Bakr Al Hazramy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Ismail<sup>as</sup> buried his<sup>as</sup> mother<sup>as</sup> in Al-Hijr, and built a chamber upon it, lest the grave of the mother<sup>as</sup> of Ismail<sup>as</sup> be trampled upon in Al-Hijr’ (by those who circle the Kaaba).
